study_type_evidence.quote: Api137 dissolved in 0.9% saline was injected iv or sc in mice (18–26 g, total = 51) and rats (204–248 g, total = 12)
which was slightly above the MIC of Api137 against E. coli ATCC 25922 in vitro (4 mg/L)

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: female CD-1 (Charles River); 18-26 g for PK injections, 22-30 g for the tolerance study, 24-32 g for pump PK, 20-28 g in the infection models; age not reported
in_vivo_species.quote: Female CD-1 mice and female Sprague Dawley (SD) rats were obtained from Charles River Laboratory (Wilmington, MA) and acclimated in randomized groups for at least 5 days before use.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: female Sprague Dawley (Charles River); 204-248 g for PK, 218-260 g for tolerance; age not reported
in_vivo_species.quote: Api137 dissolved in 0.9% saline was injected iv or sc in mice (18–26 g, total = 51) and rats (204–248 g, total = 12)

in_vitro_detail: Minimal inhibitory concentration of Api137 against Escherichia coli ATCC 25922 (4 mg/L). ALZET osmotic pump flow-rate verification by incubating primed pumps in 0.9% saline at 37 C and quantifying released peptide by reversed-phase chromatography.

agents.name: Api137
agents.sequence: Gu-ONNRPVYIPRPRPPHPRL-OH (Gu = N,N,N',N'-tetramethylguanidino; O = L-ornithine; C-terminal free acid)
agents.chemical_identifier: peptide acetate salt, CBL Patras (Patras, Greece); a 13C5,15N-L-proline position-16 labelled version was synthesized in house
agents.group_n: n = 3 per dose and time point for PK; n = 6 per treated group and n = 12 untreated control in the infection models; n = 9 per dose (total = 27) for the pump PK study
agents.group_n_quote: Three mice per dose and time point were euthanized by carbon dioxide inhalation and blood was collected via cardiac puncture
agents.dose: PK: single and multiple iv or sc injections at 5, 10 and 20 mg/kg BW (dose volumes 10 mL/kg iv in mice, 5 mL/kg in rats; sc 10 mL/kg). Tolerance: 5, 10, 25 and 50 mg/kg iv. Infection: iv 10 and 20 mg/kg or sc 60 and 100 mg/kg at 1, 4, 8 and 12 h post infection. Continuous sc infusion: 6.4, 12.8 and 19.2 mg/kg/h (daily doses 154, 307 and 461 mg/kg) by ALZET pump at 8 uL/h; an earlier pump series used 9.6, 12.8 and 16 mg/kg/h.
agents.route: intravenous (tail vein), subcutaneous (back) injection, and continuous subcutaneous infusion via implanted ALZET mini-osmotic pump
agents.dose_route_quote: Here, the pharmacokinetics of Api137 are studied after iv and subcutaneous (sc) administration with doses of 5, 10, and 20 mg/kg BW in mice and rats.
agents.half_life_matrix: mouse EDTA plasma (matrix of the PK measurements)
agents.cmax: Mouse, 5 min after single iv 5/10/20 mg/kg: 6.8, 12.9 and 23.2 mg/L. Mouse, 5 min after single sc 5/10/20 mg/kg: 0.4, 0.9 and 2.9 mg/L. Rat iv: 4.0-9.8 mg/L (not dose dependent). Rat sc 5/10/20 mg/kg: 0.1, 0.4 and 0.8 mg/L. Continuous sc infusion gave steady plasma levels of 1.6, 3.5 and 5.9 mg/L for 6.4, 12.8 and 19.2 mg/kg/h.
agents.tmax: not reported; the highest concentrations were measured at the earliest sampling time of 5 min post injection, and steady state was reached about 4 h after pump implantation
agents.pk_quote: single iv injections of 5, 10, and 20 mg/kg led to dose-dependent plasma levels of 6.8, 12.9, and 23.2 mg/L after 5 min, respectively ... After 30 min, the plasma levels decreased to 0.09 mg/L, 0.30 mg/L and 0.44 mg/L
agents.pk_section: RESULTS / Pharmacokinetics With Intravenous and Subcutaneous Injection

agents.name: Api137(1-17) and Api137(1-16) metabolites
agents.sequence: not reported in this paper (identified only as metabolites 1-17 and 1-16 of Api137)
agents.group_n: n = 3 per time point (medium dose group)
agents.group_n_quote: Each data point represents the mean peptide concentration in plasma samples obtained from three individual mice
agents.dose: not administered; formed in vivo from Api137 delivered at 12.8 mg/kg/h
agents.dose_route_quote: Api137 plasma levels of the medium dose group (12.8 mg/kg/h, blue, open squares) were confirmed and metabolites Api137(1-17) ... and Api137(1-16) ... were determined in house
agents.cmax: stable plasma levels of around 1 mg/L over 24 h
agents.pk_quote: Additional quantification of the two major metabolites Api137(1-17) and (1-16) resulted in stable plasma levels of around 1 mg/L over 24 h (Figure 4B).
agents.pk_section: RESULTS / Pharmacokinetics With Continuous Subcutaneous Infusion

concentration_time_figure.locator: Figure 1A and 1B (single iv and sc dose), Figure 2A and 2B (multiple iv doses), Figure 4A and 4B (continuous sc infusion, including metabolites), Figure 6 (measured infusion curve vs predicted multiple-injection curves)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Plasma concentration of Api137 in CD-1 mice after single dose iv (A; full lines) and sc (B; dashed lines) injection of 5 (▲), 10 (◆), and 20 mg/kg BW (■), respectively.
concentration_time_figure.note: Multiple true plasma concentration versus time plots. Fig. 1 covers single iv/sc doses in mice; Fig. 2 two and three consecutive iv injections; Fig. 4A the three continuous sc infusion dose groups over 24 h and Fig. 4B the medium dose group with Api137(1-17) and Api137(1-16) metabolites; Fig. 6 overlays measured infusion data with predicted multiple-injection profiles used for AUC estimation. Rat profiles are in Supplementary Figures 3 and 4.

bioanalytical_method: Reversed-phase chromatography (Acquity UPLC, C18 BEH column) coupled online to electrospray ionization tandem mass spectrometry (XEVO TQS), after solid-phase extraction on a WCX micro-elution plate, with Api134 as internal standard; LLOQ 5 ug/L
bioanalytical_quote: Api137 was quantified in EDTA plasma samples using reversed-phase chromatography (RP-HPLC) coupled to electrospray ionization mass spectrometry (ESI-MS/MS) at TNO Triskelion (Zeist, Netherlands). Analog Api134 was used as internal standard.
notes: IMPORTANT: the half-life value of '< 30 min' carried in the PeplLife2 metadata appears ONLY in the abstract. No half-life, t1/2 or elimination-rate value is stated anywhere after '=== BODY ==='; the body reports only concentrations at discrete time points and an AUC. half_life is therefore recorded as 'not reported in body'. The body's only elimination statement is qualitative: 'Api137 is very rapidly eliminated from the blood stream'. AUC values reported in the body (Fig. 6 caption and Discussion) are 89 ug*min/mL for continuous sc infusion at 19.2 mg/kg/h over 6-20 h post implantation, versus predicted 92 (iv) and 7 (sc) ug*min/mL for 10 mg/kg every 30 min. The ED50 for 50% survival by continuous sc infusion was 13.4 mg/kg/h. Two separate pump experiments exist: an initial series primed for 3 h at doses of 9.6, 12.8 and 16 mg/kg/h that gave inconsistent, non-dose-dependent plasma levels, and an optimized series primed for 6 h at 6.4, 12.8 and 19.2 mg/kg/h that gave the stable levels reported above. Tolerance findings: 50 mg/kg iv was lethal in mice within 1 min. Prior-publication PK values quoted in the Introduction for comparison (Onc72 and Onc112 at 1.8/5.4 mg/L ip and 5.7/8.4 mg/L iv; Api88 and Api137 at 1.0/0.4 mg/L iv and 0.6/0.2 mg/L ip after 5 mg/kg) are cited from earlier work, not measured here. Rat PK values are given in the Results text but the corresponding figures are in the Supplementary Material.
